sources.title: British Council LearnEnglish — English Grammar Reference

rules.title: Present Simple: third-person singular

model.target: She studies engineering.

explanation.en: With a third-person singular subject, the present simple normally ends in -s/-es.
explanation.ru: С he/she/it в Present Simple обычно добавляется -s/-es.

caveats: be and have have irregular forms
Modal verbs do not take third-person -s

rules.title: Present Simple: negatives
rules.canonical_pattern: I/you/we/they + don't + base verb; he/she/it + doesn't + base verb

model.target: Gender doesn't determine talent.

explanation.en: The lexical verb remains in base form after do/does not.
explanation.ru: После don't/doesn't смысловой глагол стоит в начальной форме.

caveats: Be and modals form negatives differently

rules.title: Present Continuous

model.target: More women are studying computer science.

explanation.en: Use a form of be plus -ing to describe an action in progress.
explanation.ru: Используйте am/is/are и глагол с -ing.

caveats: Many stative verbs are not normally continuous

rules.title: Past Simple: affirmative and negative
rules.canonical_pattern: affirmative: past form; negative: didn't + base verb

model.target: She joined the team last year.
model.translation: Она присоединилась к команде в прошлом году.

explanation.en: After didn't use the base verb, not the past form.
explanation.ru: После didn't используется начальная форма глагола.

caveats: The verb be forms negatives with wasn't/weren't

rules.title: Past Continuous

model.target: Women were entering new professions.

explanation.en: The continuous past needs was/were and the -ing form.
explanation.ru: Past Continuous: was/were + глагол с -ing.

caveats: Use was with I/he/she/it and were with you/we/they
Not all verbs are normally used in continuous forms

rules.title: Present Perfect Simple

model.target: Opportunities have expanded over time.

explanation.en: Use have with plural subjects, has with singular third person.
explanation.ru: С множественным подлежащим — have, с he/she/it — has.

caveats: Past Simple usually accompanies finished past-time markers such as yesterday

rules.title: Past Perfect

model.target: She had completed the course before she applied.
model.translation: Она окончила курс до того, как подала заявление.

explanation.en: Past Perfect uses had plus the past participle.
explanation.ru: Past Perfect образуется с had и третьей формой глагола.

caveats: Past Perfect is not compulsory every time two past events are mentioned

rules.title: Future with will

model.target: More people will consider these careers.
model.translation: Больше людей будут рассматривать эти профессии.

explanation.en: After will use the base form.
explanation.ru: После will используется начальная форма глагола.

caveats: Will is not the only way to refer to future time

rules.title: Modal verbs + base verb

model.target: Employers should offer equal opportunities.

incorrect_for_target.text: Employers should to offer equal opportunities.

explanation.en: Core modals such as can, must and should are followed by a bare infinitive.
explanation.ru: После can, must, should используется инфинитив без to.

caveats: Ought to and have to use to; they are not core bare-infinitive modals

rules.title: Passive Voice

model.target: The policy was introduced in 2020.

explanation.en: Passive constructions use a form of be with a past participle.
explanation.ru: Страдательный залог: форма be + причастие прошедшего времени.

caveats: Get-passives exist
Not every verb can be passivized

rules.title: First Conditional
rules.canonical_pattern: if + present simple, will + base verb (typical pattern)

model.target: If schools encourage girls, more will choose engineering.
model.translation: Если школы будут поддерживать девочек, больше из них выберут инженерное дело.

grammatical: If schools encourage girls, more will choose engineering.

incorrect_for_target.text: If schools will encourage girls, more will choose engineering.

explanation.en: The typical predictive conditional uses present tense in the if-clause.
explanation.ru: В типичном условном предложении первого типа после if используется Present Simple.

caveats: Will may occur in if-clauses with special volitional meanings
Other modal verbs may replace will

rules.title: Second Conditional
rules.canonical_pattern: if + past simple, would + base verb (typical pattern)

model.target: If salaries were equal, fewer people would leave.
model.translation: Если бы зарплаты были равными, меньше людей уходило бы.

grammatical: If salaries were equal, fewer people would leave.

incorrect_for_target.text: If salaries would be equal, fewer people would leave.

explanation.en: Use a past-form condition and would + base verb for hypothetical situations.
explanation.ru: Для нереального условия часто используются Past Simple и would + начальная форма.

caveats: Could/might may replace would
Were can be used across persons in formal hypothetical clauses

rules.title: Third Conditional
rules.canonical_pattern: if + had + past participle, would have + past participle

model.target: If they had applied, they would have been considered.
model.translation: Если бы они подали заявления, их бы рассмотрели.

grammatical: If they had applied, they would have been considered.

incorrect_for_target.text: If they had applied, they would considered.

explanation.en: A typical unreal past conditional uses past perfect and would have + participle.
explanation.ru: Нереальное условие в прошлом: had + V3, would have + V3.

caveats: Mixed conditionals are also possible

rules.title: Defining Relative Clauses

model.target: People who work in science need support.
model.translation: Людям, которые работают в науке, нужна поддержка.

grammatical: People who work in science need support.

incorrect_for_target.text: People who they work in science need support.

explanation.en: Do not repeat the subject pronoun when who is the subject.
explanation.ru: Не дублируйте подлежащее после who.

caveats: Object relative pronouns may sometimes be omitted
That is not used in non-defining relative clauses

rules.title: Non-defining Relative Clauses

model.target: Ada, who teaches coding, mentors girls.
model.translation: Ада, которая преподаёт программирование, помогает девочкам как наставник.

grammatical: Ada, who teaches coding, mentors girls.

incorrect_for_target.text: Ada, that teaches coding, mentors girls.

explanation.en: Non-defining relatives are comma-separated; use who/which rather than that.
explanation.ru: Уточняющие придаточные выделяются запятыми; that здесь не используется.

caveats: Punctuation and meaning distinguish defining and non-defining

rules.title: Indefinite Articles

model.target: She is an engineer.

explanation.en: An indefinite singular count noun usually requires a determiner.
explanation.ru: Исчисляемому существительному в единственном числе обычно нужен определитель.

caveats: Article choice depends on pronunciation, not spelling
Some contexts use a different determiner

rules.title: Definite and Zero Articles
rules.canonical_pattern: the for identifiable referents; zero article in many general plural/mass uses

model.target: Women have entered the profession.
model.translation: Женщины начали работать в этой профессии.

incorrect_for_target.text: The women are equal to men. [intended: women in general]

explanation.en: Generic plural reference normally takes no article.
explanation.ru: При обобщённом значении множественного числа артикль часто не нужен.

caveats: The women is correct for a specific identified group

rules.title: Verb + gerund / infinitive
rules.canonical_pattern: verb-specific complement: enjoy + verb-ing; decide + to-infinitive

model.target: She enjoys mentoring students.

explanation.en: The choice of -ing or to-infinitive depends on the governing verb.
explanation.ru: Форма -ing или инфинитив с to зависит от конкретного глагола.

caveats: Some verbs accept both forms with meaning differences

rules.title: Comparatives

model.target: This policy is fairer than the old one.

grammatical: This policy is fairer than the old one.

incorrect_for_target.text: This policy is more fairer than the old one.

explanation.en: Avoid combining more with a regular -er comparative.
explanation.ru: Не используйте одновременно more и сравнительную форму на -er.

caveats: Some adjectives have irregular comparatives
Fairer and more fair can both be acceptable depending on context

rules.title: Subject–verb agreement
rules.canonical_pattern: singular subject → singular finite verb; plural subject → plural finite verb

model.target: The students are motivated.

explanation.en: Finite verb forms normally agree with the subject where relevant.
explanation.ru: Форма сказуемого согласуется с подлежащим.

caveats: Collective nouns vary by dialect and intended meaning

rules.title: Reported Speech: backshift
rules.canonical_pattern: reporting verb in past + tense backshift when context requires

model.target: She said that she was ready.

grammatical: She said that she was ready.

incorrect_for_target.text: She said that she is ready. [without context]

explanation.en: Backshift commonly occurs after a past reporting verb.
explanation.ru: После глагола сообщения в прошедшем времени часто сдвигается время.

caveats: No backshift can be correct if the fact remains true

rules.title: Negative adverbial inversion
rules.canonical_pattern: negative/restrictive adverbial + auxiliary + subject + main verb

model.target: Rarely have women been represented equally.
model.translation: Женщины редко были представлены на равных.

grammatical: Rarely have women been represented equally.

incorrect_for_target.text: Rarely women have been represented equally.

explanation.en: Fronted negative adverbials typically require subject-auxiliary inversion.
explanation.ru: После вынесенных в начало ограничительных наречий часто нужна инверсия.

caveats: Not all fronted adverbs trigger inversion
